title: Latency attribution waterfall with synthetic overlay by model & route
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Build a dashboard panel that shows an attribution-style waterfall for request latency broken down by logical components (ingress, routing, kernel-inference, kv-cache-lookup, egress), with an overlay that compares production traffic percentiles (p50/p95/p99) against synthetic benchmark runs. This will help SREs and engineers quickly identify regressions introduced by model changes, routing policies, or IO-mode (streaming vs non-streaming) differences.

Why: Current latency boards surface percentiles by route/model but it's hard to quickly attribute increases to specific service hops and to tell whether regressions appear in real traffic or only under synthetic workloads. We also want trace-linked investigation: clicking a waterfall bar should jump to a sample trace or span distribution for that component.

Scope:
- Four main widgets: waterfall-by-component, percentile-compare-over-time, streaming-vs-chunked-mode-split, and trace-linked-sample-list.
- Instrumentation changes to add a component tag to existing spans and to emit component-level timing metrics (histograms) to the metrics pipeline.
- Synthetic runner integration: run the existing perf harness (k6-based) to produce a regular synthetic baseline and write results to metrics with a synthetic=true label.
- Dashboard will support model+route filters and a time range selector with overlay toggle (show/hide synthetic).
acceptance_criteria:
1) Waterfall panel displays p50/p95/p99 contribution per component for a selected model+route and time range.
2) Synthetic overlay can be toggled and visibly overlays production percentiles for direct comparison.
3) Clicking a waterfall bar opens a list of top traces filtered to that component span and preserves the same time range.
4) Metrics emitted have the new tag dimension 'component' and 'io_mode' and are present in the metrics pipeline for >=30d retention.
5) Dashboard has annotations for active rollouts (canary/primary) and indicates when a model variant was promoted.
6) Performance cost of additional histogram metrics is under 5% of pipeline egress cost (measured in staging).
tasks: Design dashboard wireframe and panels (attach in Confluence).
Add component tag to spans in serving runtime (inference/handler/egress) and emit component histograms.
Add io_mode label (streaming, sync, chunked) to traces and metrics.
Extend metrics ingestion to accept synthetic=true label and ensure synthetic series are queryable.
Implement Grafana panels + template variables for model, route, io_mode, and synthetic toggle.
Hook trace-linking: map waterfall component -> trace query; verify links open in Tempo/Jaeger.
Run synthetic harness across representative models and store baseline; compare with production across 7 days.
Load test metrics pipeline in staging to quantify cost and cardinality impact.
trace_sample_query: service=serving-runtime component={{component}} model={{model}} route={{route}} io_mode={{io_mode}} | sort duration desc | limit 50
tracing_hooks_changes: Added span attribute 'component' with values [ingress, router, kernel, kv_cache, egress]. Instrumented start/end around kernel invocation and kv-cache lookup to produce accurate component durations. Added io_mode propagation from request header to root span. Backwards compatible: old traces still accepted if attribute missing.
metrics_pipeline_changes: Emit component-level histograms: inference.request.duration_ms{component,model,route,io_mode,synthetic}. Hooked into Metrics Ingest v2 path with batched uploads to reduce cardinality pressure. Aggregation rollups configured for 1m/5m/1h. Retention: raw 30d, rollups 90d.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: cardinality explosion from model+route+component+io_mode+synthetic. Mitigation: cap high-cardinality labels using sampling on low-volume customers and aggregate rare routes into 'other'. Risk: added overhead in runtime for extra instrumentation. Mitigation: lightweight timers and conditional emission behind feature flag.
rollout_plan: 1) Feature-flag instrumentation to staging (week 1). 2) Deploy dashboard and synthetic runner; run 48h comparison (week 2). 3) Gradual rollout to 10% of hosts with sampling enabled for low-volume routes (week 3). 4) Full rollout when pipeline cost <5% increase and QA signoff (week 4).
qa_checklist: Staging traces contain 'component' and 'io_mode' attributes for sampled requests.
Histogram series appear in Metrics Explore for multiple models and io_modes.
Synthetic overlay displays correct time series when synthetic=true label is used.
Trace links from waterfall open Tempo and show filtered spans.
notes: Spoke with PM (Ava Patel) and Design (Liam Brooks) to prioritize waterfall-first UX; design prefers p50/p95/p99 stacked view plus absolute ms annotations.
SREs requested server-side sampling controls to limit high-cardinality metric emission; task added to dependencies.
Cost estimate: ~10k additional metric series in worst-case; will validate in staging after initial rollout.
